list.name: client_platform
list.label: 客户端平台
list.query: WebGL : webgl,Windows Player : windows,Unity Editor : editor,其他客户端 : other,未知/历史未上报 : unknown,无客户端归属 : unattributed

list.name: release_version
list.label: 发布版本
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __text,COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __value FROM analytics_sessions ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: test_data
list.label: 测试数据
list.query: 按平台自动 : auto,排除 : exclude,包含 : include,仅测试 : only

options.content: **默认包含 WebGL、Windows Player 和未知/历史未上报；可单独筛选 Unity Editor。** 旧客户端没有上报平台的记录在「未知/历史未上报」中，不能根据版本名推断。平台多选按用户去重。旧游戏事件缺少真实时间，见经营总览及猫与 AI 页的「历史累计」；这些面板不受右上角时间范围影响。期间事件面板为空不代表历史没有行为。所有日期按北京时间。测试数据「按平台自动」会在 Editor 中保留测试记录。

panels.title: 历史全量平台覆盖（不受筛选）
panels.description: 专门展示历史平台缺失，防止默认正式平台筛选掩盖旧数据。

targets.queryText: SELECT client_platform 平台,COUNT(*) 会话数,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) 玩家数 FROM analytics_sessions GROUP BY client_platform
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT client_platform 平台,COUNT(*) 会话数,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) 玩家数 FROM analytics_sessions GROUP BY client_platform

panels.title: 期间事件字段覆盖
panels.description: 遵守时间、平台和版本筛选。缺失值不补零；历史事件没有真实时间时不纳入期间统计。

targets.queryText: WITH e AS (SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor'))) AND julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch') ) SELECT COUNT(*) 事件数,SUM(event_id IS NOT NULL) 有事件ID,SUM(client_platform NOT IN ('unknown','unattributed')) 已知平台,SUM(json_extract(payload_json,'$.request_stats.llm_request_id') IS NOT NULL) 有模型关联ID FROM e
targets.rawQueryText: WITH e AS (SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor'))) AND julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch') ) SELECT COUNT(*) 事件数,SUM(event_id IS NOT NULL) 有事件ID,SUM(client_platform NOT IN ('unknown','unattributed')) 已知平台,SUM(json_extract(payload_json,'$.request_stats.llm_request_id') IS NOT NULL) 有模型关联ID FROM e

panels.title: 历史缺时间记录（不受时间筛选）
panels.description: 遵守时间、平台和版本筛选。缺失值不补零；历史事件没有真实时间时不纳入期间统计。

targets.queryText: SELECT client_platform,event_type,COUNT(*) 缺时间条数 FROM gameplay_events WHERE event_real_time_iso IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT client_platform,event_type,COUNT(*) 缺时间条数 FROM gameplay_events WHERE event_real_time_iso IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: 数据更新时间（不受筛选）
panels.description: 遵守时间、平台和版本筛选。缺失值不补零；历史事件没有真实时间时不纳入期间统计。

targets.queryText: SELECT '心跳' 数据源,MAX(received_at) 最近入库 FROM play_session_events UNION ALL SELECT '增量事件',MAX(received_at) FROM gameplay_live_events UNION ALL SELECT '退出快照',MAX(imported_at) FROM gameplay_sessions UNION ALL SELECT '中转请求',MAX(timestamp) FROM conversations
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT '心跳' 数据源,MAX(received_at) 最近入库 FROM play_session_events UNION ALL SELECT '增量事件',MAX(received_at) FROM gameplay_live_events UNION ALL SELECT '退出快照',MAX(imported_at) FROM gameplay_sessions UNION ALL SELECT '中转请求',MAX(timestamp) FROM conversations

panels.title: 期间会话可信度
panels.description: 遵守时间、平台和版本筛选。缺失值不补零；历史事件没有真实时间时不纳入期间统计。

targets.queryText: WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM analytics_sessions WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor'))) AND julianday(started_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(started_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch') ) SELECT client_platform,duration_source,confidence,COUNT(*) 会话数 FROM s GROUP BY 1,2,3
